entries.en: Rigorously as we work, we quickly wear down our tools until there's nothing left save the hilt. And a tool with only a hilt is no tool at all, I'm sure you'll agree.
entries.fr: Qhoterl Pasol avoir besoin de beaucouuup d'outils ! Outils s'uuuser très vite, alors toujours besoin de nouveaux !
entries.ja:
発掘作業には、様々な道具が必要になりまする～。
そして、道具は使えば消耗しますゆえ、
常に補充が必要になりまする～。

entries.en: To be sure, not all of our implements have hilts, but the point stands that we need to replace them quite regularly. And it's my responsibility to ensure that we always have the materials with which to make them.

その調達に、ご協力くださいましな～。
